messages:
maria: quick sync — we need a proposal for unified GPU metrics + dashboard coverage for Hosted + Dedicated pools. focus: SM occupancy, per-GPU memory, and queue depth. who owns collection vs UI vs alerts?

aj: do we have a canonical naming scheme yet? need to avoid high-cardinality labels. also: what aggregation windows do we want?

tao: proposal for metric names / types ->
- `gpu.sm_occupancy_pct{pool_type, pool_id, region, model_variant}` (gauge)
- `gpu.memory_used_bytes{pool_type, pool_id, gpu_index}` (gauge)
- `gpu.sm_queue_depth{pool_type, pool_id, queue_name}` (histogram or gauge + counters)
Keep labels: `pool_type: hosted|dedicated`, `pool_id` for Dedicated, `region`, `model_variant` optional. avoid per-request ids.

kevin: ingestion cost warning: memory metrics at per-gpu per-10s will blow up cardinality. suggest `gpu.memory_used_bytes` at 1m resolution and only expose per-gpu for Dedicated. Hosted: roll up to `pool_id` or `pool_type` only.

jen-ops: console implications: Dedicated customers want per-tenant dashboards and per-tenant quota visibility (slots / reserved capacity). Hosted wants overall health + headroom warnings. dashboard should allow toggling granularity.

leah-pm: product: need sensible alert defaults and a rollout UX. e.g., a canary that surfaces sm_occupancy > 85% p95 for 10m. Also want a 'what changed' link to recent model rollouts affecting utilization.

sre-bot: note: `gpu.sm_util` exists in prod ingest (retention 14d) but it's node-level and lacks pool_type/pool_id. tagging will require runtime change.

aj: tagging runtime is fine but watch label cardinality: `model_variant` can be high. we should allow `model_variant` only on dedicated dashboards or sample it. otherwise produce aggregated `model_family`.

maria: internal metrics ingest API idea (very small):
```
POST /internal/v1/metrics/gpu
payload: [{"metric":"gpu.sm_occupancy_pct","labels":{"pool_type":"hosted","pool_id":"p-123","region":"us-west"},"value":72.3,"ts":2146789011}]
```
We can require `pool_id` only for Dedicated.

tao: resolution proposal: SM occupancy 15s -> 1m rollups, memory 1m, queue depth as histogram with p50/p95/p99 computed server-side. saves storage and preserves signal.

kevin: queue depth should have two flavors: `queue_in_flight` (instant) and `queue_enqueue_rate` (counter -> rate). histograms for latency within queue. p50/p95/p99 for queue length makes alerting easier.

jen-ops: dashboards: eng-platform owns the shared dashboards for Hosted health. eng-runtime owns instrumenting the metrics. devex owns per-customer dashboard templates for Dedicated. we need a doc mapping owners + sample queries.

leah-pm: rollout plan suggestion: 1) land labels + low-cardinality hosted rollup (canary across single region), 2) add per-gpu memory for dedicated customers behind feature flag, 3) enable histograms and alerts in console (opt-out for early dedicated customers). timeline: 3 weeks to canary, 6 weeks to full.

maria: action items: 
- tao + kevin: draft runtime tagging PR and resolution defaults (due Thu)
- aj + jen-ops: dashboard wireframe + sample queries (due Fri)
- leah-pm + maria: alert defaults and rollout opt-in copy (due Mon)
- devex: template for Dedicated per-tenant view (TBD owner)
I'll also open an RFC in google docs with examples and cost estimates.

aj: +1 to that plan. can we include a cost estimate table for ingest (tiered by resolution)? I'll mock one.

kevin: I'll run a quick simulation with 1m vs 15s retention sizes tomorrow and paste numbers.

maria: thanks — last ask: avoid adding `session_id` or other high-card labels. prefer explicit sampling flags if we need traces.

leah-pm: also add a note about privacy/compliance: Dedicated customers in EU might require aggregated metrics only (no per-gpu indices). we should have a config flag per customer.

maria: perfect. i'll follow up with RFC link and assign tickets after tao + aj PRs land. :thumbsup:
